general.title: General
general.description: Project name, description, export, and API tokens.

export.title: Export project
export.description: Download a ZIP with all suites, cases, executions, bugs and attachments.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Project-scoped tokens used by the listener and external clients.

integrations.title: External trackers
integrations.description: Connect Jira, OpenProject, GitLab, or Azure DevOps to sync bugs.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Outbound HTTP notifications when project events happen.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: These actions affect the whole project. Proceed with care.

archive.title: Archive project
archive.description: Hides the project from active lists. Reversible — you can unarchive at any time.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: Move ownership to another active user. You will lose owner privileges on this project.

delete.title: Delete project
delete.description: Permanently delete this project and all of its data. This cannot be undone.
delete.intro: All suites, cases, executions, bugs, comments, and attachments will be deleted. To confirm, type the project name below.
